items.title: EU faces mixed prospects in tech sovereignty, new policy brief finds

main_radar_links.title: EU faces mixed prospects in tech sovereignty, new policy brief finds

items.original_context: EU technological sovereignty differs sharply by field: strong in advanced manufacturing and robotics, weak in artificial intelligence, with chip imports and Chinese energy-technology dominance as persistent vulnerabilities.
items.investigation_question: Does this research output reveal a broader China pattern in technology leadership and industrial capacity, or is it a single isolated publication? Seek independent evidence.
